scope: Two new auxiliary file-store/module test files
Maintained lifecycle RFC and sanitized source evidence

review.kind: Delegated release-engineering preparation and primary implementation/failure-boundary review

limitations: Tests use synthetic state and temporary Linux filesystems with narrowly simulated ownership/mount observations; no retained production generation or live lab was invoked.
Local ext4/xfs ancestry/mount checks are observed identity restrictions, not physical provenance; arbitrary filesystem syscalls are not wall-clock bounded.
The separate auxiliary flock coordinates cooperating writers. Compare then replace is not atomic content CAS against uncooperative/root writers.
Completed file/directory fsync and readback are not power-loss-tested recovery or independent off-site backup.
An unacknowledged publication yields no advanced receipt, retry, rollback or automatic recovery. Cold load only reports historical record consistency.
Persisting reported IDs does not establish attributable Docker creation, resource ownership, volume continuity or runtime permission.
Secure provisioning/materialization, attributable retained resources, interrupted-write and volume reconciliation, lifecycle operations and the complete recovery harness remain unfinished.
Disconnected VM/console, operator replacement scope, physical/material/runtime admission, global release/lint, H7/W16, Coordinator and private-backup gates remain open.
